# apple_end_pre_orders (Action)

Ends an app's pre-orders in territories, releasing the app there now instead of on its release date. The territories' `release_date` is cleared, which `apple_app_territory_availability` then shows as a change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_end_pre_orders" "launch" {
  config {
    app_id      = data.apple_app.example.id
    territories = ["USA", "CAN"]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `territories` (Set of String) Territories whose pre-orders end, e.g. `USA`.
